name: p6_kfib_neg
statement: (k : ℤ) (m : ℕ) : p6_kfib k (-(m : ℤ)) = (-1) ^ (m + 1) * p6_kfib k (m : ℤ)
informal: Sec 2.2 (unnumbered): f_{-m} = (-1)^{m+1} f_m [m taken as a natural number (the paper says 'by induction').]
type: ∀ (k : ℤ) (m : ℕ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (-↑m) = (-1) ^ (m + 1) * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k ↑m
